tool: Heaptrack 1.5.0, verified Fedora RPM extracted privately; CLI analysis
scope: Native graphics, two five-course tours, sound output off; profiler overhead is separate from ordinary RSS. Raw traces stay private. Allocation call totals depend on sampled frame count and cannot be directly compared as per-frame costs.
exit_retention_note: Nonzero process-exit retention is reported, including framework/global caches. Persistent raster workers intentionally live until process exit. Scene weak-owner expiration and warmed image/index counts are checked separately.
failed_optional_viewer: Capture completed successfully. Wrapper then attempted its optional GUI, unavailable because libKChart6.so.3 was absent; CLI analysis succeeded without installing libraries. Future captures use --record-only.
